messages:
maya: quick heads-up — prepping regional maintenance message for tomorrow night 23:00 UTC, staggered by region. Need statuspage + email/snippet and rollback language.
sam: timeline ok. staging rollout starts 23:00 UTC -> eu-west-1, 23:30 -> us-west-2, 00:15 -> ap-southeast-1. each region 20m window. I'll pin canaries.
customer-success: draft for customers — short, clear, and prescriptive. keep "what to expect" + "when" + "contact". Include fallbacks if we roll back.
nate: add SLA note: "We expect <1% request error rate increase during window; if exceeded we will pause and rollback." Also add link to support form: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/new
maya: can you sketch the statuspage snippet? want one-liner + detailed body.
customer-success: sure. Draft below:

```
• Short: Scheduled maintenance — regional runtime update
• When: 2026-05-14 23:00 UTC (staggered by region)
• Impact: brief request throttling or increased latency for up to 20 minutes per region
• What we’ll do: rolling update with canaries; automatic rollback on error threshold
• Contact: https://status.redwood.ai and support@redwood.ai
```

Use that for statuspage and email hero.

Also email subject ideas:
- "Redwood scheduled maintenance (may affect latency) — 14 May"
- "Planned regional update — possible short interruptions"

sam: looks good. For status page component we usually use markdown. Add component tag and regions list.

customer-success: added markdown snippet:

```
### Scheduled maintenance — regional runtime update
**When:** 2026-05-14 23:00 UTC (staggered by region: EU -> US -> APAC)
**Expected impact:** brief increased latency or throttling for up to ~20 minutes per region.
**What we're doing:** rolling GPU runtime update with canaries and automated rollback. If we hit error rate >=0.5% or latency >2x baseline we will pause and roll back.
**Updates:** will post progress here and on the status page: https://status.redwood.ai
**Need help?** contact support@redwood.ai or open a ticket.
```

nate: add one more line: "Customers using Dedicated or Private: your pinned deployments will not be changed unless you've opted into autosync. Contact your CSM for manual coordination." 
customer-success: added.

deploy-bot: [deploy] start rollout eu-west-1 pool-42 by sam at 2026-05-14T23:00:00Z
maya: ok. final ask — include rollback communication snippet when we have to roll back.

customer-success: rollback snippet:

```
Subject: Redwood maintenance rollback — service restored
Body: We paused the planned update and rolled back the runtime in {region} at {time} due to elevated error rates. Service has been restored to pre-update behavior. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with a postmortem. If you see ongoing issues, contact support@redwood.ai.
```

maya: perfect. I'll push this to statuspage composer and schedule the email. tagging @nate for SLA note approval.
nate: approved. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks everyone — posting now and scheduling sends. will paste the final statuspage URL once live.
